name: Salesforce Intelligence
description: Ask your AI what breaks before you change Salesforce. Offline, read-only answers cited from an org's real metadata: field deletion safety, what runs on save, who can see a record, dependency impact. Serves a local org-kb vault built by the sfi CLI. Not affiliated with Salesforce.
author: PranavNagrecha

SFI_VAULT.description: Absolute path to the org-kb vault built by `sfi init` and `sfi refresh` in your Salesforce DX project. Without it the server starts in setup mode and lists one tool (sfi.setup_status).
